notes:
Inbound from YC-alum fintech. Signed up self-serve (trial credits used). Primary contact: CTO Marcus Lin (marcus@paylattice.ai). Use-case: helpdesk chatbot + embedding-powered doc search for compliance and product docs; second phase: reranking transaction signals for fraud scoring. Latency sensitive for chat (p50 < 250ms target for short prompts) and moderate throughput (200–400 reqs/min peak for support flows). Cost conscious — prefers pay-as-you-go hosted API initially; will consider Dedicated once ARR and throughput justify it.

Security: asked about SOC2 scope and SSO/SAML integration on first call — "we need to show SOC2 to our compliance board next month". Also asked if audit logs + simple KMS key support available on hosted; curious about VPC/private later but wants hosted to move fast.

Model preferences: open models preferred for cost control but willing to test Redwood-curated variants if latency/cost tradeoffs better. Asked about automatic fallback to smaller quantized variants when load spikes.

Sales touches: inbound demo request 2024-11-14; AE outreach and quick notes sent; trial token usage indicates embedding API experiments. CTO referenced competitor evals (OpenAI + Cohere).

Quote from Marcus on call: "We need something that just works with low ops overhead — can get to market fast but we can't expose PII in logs without control."

Next actions: SE deep-dive on security + sample config for SAML + SOC2 summary + preliminary cost projection. Need to include short how-to for prefix caching and token controls for support flow.

Internal: potential upsell path to Dedicated in 9–12 months if throughput/speed needs increase. Keep as high-touch until legal has SOC2 answers.
